scenes.say: Ever struggled to make complex layouts in your projects? What tool solves it best?

scenes.label: Grid
scenes.sub: Two-dimensional system for rows and columns.
scenes.say: CSS Grid is a two-dimensional system. It lets you control both rows and columns at the same time.
Here's a basic grid. This code creates two columns: one part to two parts, with a twenty pixel gap.
Use Grid for layouts needing both rows and columns, like dashboards. Flexbox is better for single direction layouts, such as navigation bars.

scenes.question: When should you use CSS Grid?
scenes.right: When you need to control both rows and columns.
scenes.say: Interview trap: Don't say you use Grid for every layout. Use it when you need to manage both rows and columns.
